caption:
Do not buy the ticket before your visa is approved.

People do it believing it strengthens the application. It does not — consulates ask for reservations, not purchased tickets.

If you are refused, or your dates move, that money is gone. Proper reservations do exactly what the application requires: show a real, dated, coherent plan.

slides.headline: DON'T BUY THE TICKET YET.
slides.note: Buying early does not strengthen anything. It just puts your airfare at risk.

slides.body: A confirmed reservation is what the consulate asks for. A paid ticket is what you lose if the answer is no.
slides.note: Buying early proves nothing about your intent and costs you everything if it goes wrong.

slides.headline: NEVER GAMBLE AIRFARE ON AN OUTCOME THAT HASN'T HAPPENED.
slides.sub: We issue the reservations for you.

slides.headline: THE ADVICE YOU WILL HEAR
slides.never: "Buy the tickets first, it shows commitment." It shows nothing. Consulates assess documents, not spending, and the money is gone either way.
slides.instead: Hold proper reservations that match your itinerary exactly, and buy once you have a decision in hand.

slides.headline: RESERVATIONS ARE PART OF THE FILE.
